citation.title: The effect of plasma shape and neutral beam mix on the rotation threshold for RMP-ELM suppression
citation.authors: C. Paz-Soldan, R. Nazikian, L. Cui, B. C. Lyons, D. M. Orlov, A. Kirk, N. C. Logan, T. Osborne, W. Suttrop, D. Weisberg
citation.venue: Nuclear Fusion (per source record hint; not stated in the extracted text)
citation.doi_or_arxiv: 10.1088/1741-4326/ab04c0 (identifier hint only; not printed in the extracted text)

topic: DIII-D RMP-ELM suppression rotation threshold: ExB zero-crossing location, upper-triangularity shape, and NBI torque mix.
own_question: Which flow profile and pedestal conditions control the loss or access of RMP-ELM suppression?
actual_method_and_evidence: Uses offline time-dependent profile fits of carbon CER (toroidal and poloidal C6+ flow) and Thomson data in 20–50 ms windows. Supported by M3D-C1 linear MHD modeling and TRANSP torque calculations. Dataset is DIII-D, not KSTAR. No nowcasting, BES/ECEI use, or prediction is performed.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Pedestal analyses on DIII-D have relied on offline-averaged carbon CER profiles.
claim_checks.qualification: Applies to rotation from carbon impurity measurements, not to impurity Ti nowcasting. Supports the background only and does not justify a real-time need.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Offline profiles every 20 ms, aggregating CER data taken every 2–5 ms. A 3 krad/s systematic uncertainty is assumed for CER. Report arrival latency is not addressed.
validation_if_relevant: Not applicable; this is an observational threshold study.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer that KSTAR CES temperature nowcasting is needed or beneficial.
Do not treat CER rotation as equivalent to temperature.
Do not cite it as evidence of real-time control.
Do not generalize its findings to all prior work.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Off-topic for causal CES Ti nowcasting from BES/ECEI. At most, it is an optional example of offline carbon CER pedestal analysis. Excluding it is recommended.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
